correctness.rationale: For sorted absolute magnitudes a_k, the signed top-k indicators give x=sum_k (a_k−a_{k+1})s_k, with the same nonnegative coefficients giving the norm as sum_k (a_k−a_{k+1})W_k. Triangle inequality reduces the supremum exactly to these indicators (ties and zero coefficients are harmless). On a proper support of k coordinates with q runs, b internal sign changes give b twos and 2q ones, so the numerator is W_b+W_{b+2q}; b<=k−q and k+q<=n. Increasing q in W_{k−q}+W_{k+q} changes it by w_{k+q+1}−w_{k−q}<=0 wherever both spreads are feasible. A single alternating run attains the q=1 value. Full supports have even sign-flip count and attain n for even n or n−1 for odd n. This covers n=2, where the two directed differences count the same pair in opposite directions. In odd dimensions each proper-support gap from 2 is (w_k−w_{k+1})/W_k and the full-support gap is 2w_n/W_n. For alpha=1/p, derivative of (1−t)^alpha+(1+t)^alpha is negative on (0,1); k=n−1 therefore maximizes the proper branch. AM–GM beats the full branch since the difference 1−1/(n−1)^2−((n−1)/n)^2 has numerator 2n²(n−3)+4n−1 over n²(n−1)^2, positive for n>=3. Its even Taylor expansion gives defect alpha(1−alpha)/(n−1)^2 plus order (n−1)^−4. Inspected checker.py and its recorded stdout (check_output.txt line 40); the 39 finite cases are not a proof, and the submitted script was not executed.
